general_information.summary: Situated within the most enchanting cultural heritage complex in Vietnam, Vinpearl Golf Nam Hoi An is a visual spectacle with its natural sandy terrain, ever-changing seasonal landscapes, and unique local flora. The course design, characterized by broad fairways and gently undulating greens, invites golfers into an intimate connection with nature, providing an enjoyable and surprising experience without undue pressure. Conveniently located 45 minutes by car from Da Nang International Airport and 17 kilometers South of Hoi An Old Town, Vinpearl Golf Nam Hoi An stands as a must-visit destination for golf enthusiasts and visitors on the journey of exploring the S-shaped land.

general_information.summary: Set amidst the vast lush primeval forest in the North of Phu Quoc Island, Vinpearl Golf Phu Quoc offers a unique golfing experience in the untouched beauty of pristine nature. Here, golfers can distinctly appreciate the charm of gently rolling and undulating fairways, seamlessly blending into the breathtaking scenery of the ancient forest. The golf course also offers golfers an amazing opportunity to engage with the fascinating world of natural flora and fauna while absorbing the pure vitality of this paradise island.

location.full_address: Tan Thong Hoi Commune (formerly Cu Chi District), Ho Chi Minh City

general_information.summary: Located in Tan Thong Hoi Commune (formerly Cu Chi District), Ho Chi Minh City – Vietnam’s vibrant hub of economy and entertainment – Vinpearl Golf Léman boasts a 36-hole championship course, strategically crafted in the “Riparian Habitat” style. In Phase 1, the North Course with 18 signature holes is officially open, featuring legendary template holes: The Dell, The Biarritz, The Redan, and The Volcano – each a true test of strategy and precision. Vinpearl Golf Léman stands as the ultimate destination for golfers seeking inspiring rounds of leisure play, competitive tournaments, and prestigious championships of national and international scale.
